notes.title: Winter Sale and Winter Update !
notes.content:
It's that time of the year ! To celebrate the Winter sale, SOMOS just received a [b]Winter update[/b] containing a brand new Christmas challenge ! This new challenge also includes a fitting color palette. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/7b84aaab3d89a49d079b8320c289cba4afb3b431.png[/img]

In addition, a few challenges have been tweeked, including the infamous Flickers challenge ! You can also enjoy the game at 25% off for the holidays !

Happy holidays !

notes.title: Turkish Localization and Non-widescreen support
notes.content:
Hello Everyone ! 

I'm pleased to announce that patch 1.03 brings improvement for non-widescreen displays. The game's menu will look better in resolutions such as 4:3 and the obstacles should be less close to the edges of the screen with those resolutions now.  If you still run into issues with a 4:3 screen please let us know !

In addition, this change comes with a new turkish localization. Big thanks to Slevilex for making this happen ! If you'd like to help make SOMOS available in other languages, simply contact us :) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/df3cf8dc72a830b157249761b4eaeb37cc027f20.png[/img]

That's all for now. Happy autumn sale !

notes.title: SOMOS wins Innovation award at MIGA !
notes.content:
SOMOS was showcased at MEGA 2018 this weekend. I'm proud to announce that in addition to a nomination in "[i]Best Music[/i]" and a special mention in "[i]Sound Design[/i]", SOMOS won the "[i]Innovation[/i]" Award !

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/3b11b4d47013ce3f9ef576eaf18bd95969fac2bb.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/a82b43ea7fb3afd253047efd66cc10d310005e13.png[/img][/url]     [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/6e2cf45135370d8eb5f09689cb56cb9553479be6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/5b0f6851daac1581cec8a3808a14e816038e4df8.png[/img][/url]     [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/8ad020e80aac55ffcff166fbbf105b7134101709.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/fb40ad16c74f2bc331d09a2602c6144a3a349f8c.png[/img][/url]

This is great news as I hope this will bring new players to the game ! If you like the game and would like more challenges in the future, be sure to spread the good news ! :)

notes.title: SOMOS patch 1.02
notes.content:
A quick fix was made available today that should fix the issue with the "boss" achievements not being unlocked properly.

You can now get all achievements without issues !

notes.title: SOMOS patch 1.01
notes.content:
SOMOS is now officially out ! You can now explore the different challenges and bring back the colors together.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/77cbbf614b957c04d9a71267803bc57b6a552275.png[/img]

If you're having questions about the game, I created a guide that will teach you the basics so that you can start your adventure. You can find it right [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1559332761]HERE[/url].

For those looking to prove themselves, I've just fixed an issue that prevented some people to properly upload their best [i]endless[/i] score to the leaderboards. If you wish to do so, you can now compare your score among your friends and all other players [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/706510/leaderboards/2132664/]here[/url].

As you can see, there are already pretty big scores to beat !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/06d1e97d5761f52b59f4edc070eb47566c1d04fb.png[/img]


Good luck !

notes.title: SOMOS is coming out on November 8th !
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30596183/60160b6351f9d9a8986dde5a980df69301e1fb27.png[/img]

That's right ! In about two days, SOMOS will be available to play. The official release price will be [i]7.99$ US[/i], but you'll be able to get [b]15% off[/b] at release ! In Addition, SOMOS will be at the MEGA festival in Montreal this weekend. If you're near, be sure to come and say "hi" !

In SOMOS you'll encounter various challenges that each changes the rules of the game. You'll have to discover the changes of every challenge and adapt in order to bring back the colors together.

If you're feeling competitive, head over to the endless mode to try and reach for the highest score against waves of obstacles that keep getting harder !

See you Soon !
